description: A -- sequence INSIDE a single-quoted string literal is part of the string, not the start of a line comment. A prior quote-blind regex pre-strip truncated any literal containing --, so the ANTLR lexer now handles comments while respecting string literals. Pinned with the dashes leading, trailing and in the middle, as a SPLIT_PART delimiter, built by concatenation, stored in and read back from a table, and - the control - a genuine -- comment OUTSIDE a string that is still ignored. Converted 1:1 from query/StringLiteralDashTest (now retired).

steps.sql: SELECT SPLIT_PART(s, '--', 2) FROM (SELECT 'aaa--bbb' AS s) x
